caption: A block of 46 infantry on 10 files turns about in place, then is narrowed to 9 files and ordered forward in the same moment. Squaring its ranks to the new front, it now keeps every man near his place: the full files hold their ground and the rest step up a rank or across a file, at most 28.5 wu. Before this fix the re-square sent men through the block to the other end of their own file, the farthest 81.5 wu, and the men walked through each other on the way.
